# Foreign key fixtures

`fk-v2000.mdb` and `fk-v2003.mdb` are generated by
[`tools/validation/JackcessForeignKeyProbe.java`](../../tools/validation/JackcessForeignKeyProbe.java)
with the fixed Jackcess 5.2.0 JAR, and are committed so `foreign_key_v2000` /
`foreign_key_v2003` run without a JVM.

| File | Format | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `fk-v2000.mdb` | V2000 | `816695f96d4551ba643b5d98b16d8ec8459c7e777c937a4c21b14063b21323e1` |
| `fk-v2003.mdb` | V2003 | `a982cbfcd0fce07a4b0255826eeb397029dff7920a2c62a698b901286085d636` |

Each fixture holds eight relationships:

| Relationship | Tables | Referential integrity | Cascade |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ParentChild` | `Parent(Region, Code)` → `Child(ForeignRegion, ForeignCode)` | yes | updates and deletes |
| `StrictParentChild` | `StrictParent` → `StrictChild` | yes | none |
| `NullOnDelete` | `NullParent` → `NullChild` | yes | delete sets NULL |
| `ChainTopMiddle` | `ChainTop` → `ChainMiddle` | yes | updates and deletes |
| `ChainMiddleLeaf` | `ChainMiddle` → `ChainLeaf` | yes | updates and deletes |
| `TextParentChild` | `TextParent(Code)` → `TextChild(ForeignCode)` | yes | none |
| `BinParentChild` | `BinParent` → `BinChild` | yes | none |
| `GuidParentChild` | `GuidParent(Id)` → `GuidChild(ForeignId)` | yes | none |

`ParentChild` exercises the cascading path, `StrictParentChild` the plain rejection, and
`NullOnDelete` the cascade-to-NULL path. `ChainMiddle` makes its foreign key columns its primary
key, so `ChainTopMiddle` and `ChainMiddleLeaf` together force a two-level cascade. The last three
pairs cover TEXT, BINARY and GUID keys.

In every pair Jet stores the relationship alias as an extra logical index over the parent's index
data, so `Parent` and `ChainMiddle` each describe a primary key and a foreign key on one physical
index.

Regenerate after changing the generator:

```sh
javac -cp "$JACKCESS_JAR" -d "$fixture_dir" tools/validation/JackcessForeignKeyProbe.java
java -cp "$fixture_dir:$JACKCESS_JAR" JackcessForeignKeyProbe "$fixture_dir/fk-v2000.mdb" V2000
java -cp "$fixture_dir:$JACKCESS_JAR" JackcessForeignKeyProbe "$fixture_dir/fk-v2003.mdb" V2003
shasum -a 256 "$fixture_dir"/fk-v20*.mdb
```

Regeneration is only reproducible for the same Jackcess version: the fixtures follow the fixed
5.2.0 baseline commit recorded in
[`plan/Jackcess-C++重写/README.md`](../../plan/Jackcess-C++重写/README.md). Update this table and
the baseline record together when the fixture changes.

## ACE complex-column read fixtures

`complex-data-v2007.accdb`, `complex-data-v2010.accdb` and `unsupported-fields-v2007.accdb` are the
Jackcess 5.2.0 test resources `complexDataV2007.accdb`, `complexDataV2010.accdb` and
`unsupportedFieldsV2007.accdb` from the fixed upstream commit. They are Apache License 2.0 test data
and are committed unchanged so the ACE schema/row tests run without a JVM.

| File | Format | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `complex-data-v2007.accdb` | V2007 | `66c655ad9f9f290c51ed808d704c2a09a7b0d6047583c6a4c67405f708cac0c3` |
| `complex-data-v2010.accdb` | V2010 | `c9707ec54fd4f712c74ee3638963ad203fc60340f5bb7ad0c86bc2878a91e6df` |
| `unsupported-fields-v2007.accdb` | V2007 | `26f3cb28640ddc018d9093cbdf3343dac612fefc656182bf6592b00ad60ac705` |

The tests check public format/schema enumeration,
`MSysComplexColumns` links to the type/flat tables, attachment/multi-value/version-history classification,
the flat-table AutoNumber primary keys and flagged foreign-key columns, ordinary row traversal and explicit rejection of ACE read-write
opens. `ace2007_unsupported_complex` also checks that the upstream `UnknownComplex` column is classified as unsupported
while its three ordinary table rows remain readable. The tests compare multi-value and version-history text/order, attachment metadata and decoded file data, unsupported-value counts and encoded unknown-field bytes, and ACE write rejection. A separate wrapper test covers raw payload decoding and malformed headers. The upstream source and broader complex-value expectations are recorded in the
[`baseline record`](../../plan/Jackcess-C++重写/04-P0基线核验记录.md#2026-11-20-ace-复杂列样本与键关系).

## ACE V2019 extended-date read fixture

`ext-date-v2019.accdb` is the unchanged Jackcess 5.2.0 test resource `V2019/extDateV2019.accdb` (Apache License 2.0, 557,056 bytes, SHA-256 `bb6d7af8e5275c1143b5f68447b2f96bd11e460fbec6856de7b3e339ccb53cf6`). `ace2019_read` checks ACE V2019 recognition and reads `Table1.ID`, `DateExt`, and the stored result in calculated column `DateNormalCalc`. The fixed-JAR checker validates all nine rows, including NULL, nanosecond precision, and years 100, 1265, and 1765; calculated expressions are not evaluated. Newer system-table behavior remains outside this check. See [`JackcessExtendedDateCheck.java`](../../tools/validation/JackcessExtendedDateCheck.java).

## ACE V2010 calculated-field read fixture

`calc-fields-v2010.accdb` is the unchanged Jackcess 5.2.0 test resource `V2010/calcFieldV2010.accdb` (Apache License 2.0, 712,704 bytes, SHA-256 `bf95642c1e661b7fb7f615124bbb8dcc614c539fff080947ae24a1e3d6ea07dd`). The `ace2010_calculated_fields` test checks `ResultType` logical typing and the four stored rows for Boolean, TEXT, MEMO, LONG, MONEY, FLOAT, and NUMERIC results. Both C++ and the fixed-JAR checker read stored results only; neither evaluates calculated expressions. See [`JackcessCalculatedFieldCheck.java`](../../tools/validation/JackcessCalculatedFieldCheck.java) and the upstream [`CalcFieldTest.readCalcFields`](../../../jackcess/src/test/java/io/github/spannm/jackcess/impl/CalcFieldTest.java).

## Saved query fixtures

`query-v2000.mdb` and `query-v2003.mdb` are the saved-query databases shipped with the Jackcess
5.2.0 test resources (`queryTestV2000.mdb` and `queryV2003.mdb` upstream, Apache License 2.0). They
are committed unchanged so `saved_query_v2000` / `saved_query_v2003` can compare
`QueryInfo::to_sql()` against the SQL the fixed JAR prints for the same file.

| File | Format | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `query-v2000.mdb` | V2000 | `03b303034e1d64779d9dff1e19d9e21d59d8fa440dc5da9dbcfd85ad051eb5ea` |
| `query-v2003.mdb` | V2003 | `ff3512007fcbe9bf8019ec386fa4382396947b7ef3c06dfb3aa0c63f48ab88ba` |

Each file holds nine saved queries: SELECT, UPDATE, APPEND, DELETE, MAKE TABLE, CROSSTAB, UNION,
passthrough and data definition. Their expected SQL lives in `tests/query_test.cpp`; keep it in
sync with the fixtures, and re-verify with the fixed JAR before changing either.

## Descending foreign key index

Neither Jackcess nor Access creates a descending index for a relationship, so this fixture does
not carry one. The writer accepts a descending key on the child index, which was checked once on
a copy whose ascending flag was cleared by hand and reopened with the fixed Jackcess 5.2.0; see
[the baseline record](../../plan/Jackcess-C++重写/04-P0基线核验记录.md). Keep that in mind before
relying on such files: only hand-edited databases are known to contain them.
